summary: Grupo Televisa filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings report (period ended September 30, 2026, filed November 5, 2026). Revenues fell 3.8% to Ps.14,077.7 million, while operating segment income rose 5.6% to Ps.5,996.0 million (42.6% margin) and net income attributable to stockholders swung to Ps.882.7 million from a Ps.1,932.5 million loss. The filing also discloses a segment reporting change consolidating Cable and Sky into a single Telecom segment. This is a routine quarterly-results current report, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated.
